<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 224.1201 with an M+1 peak ~17.5 % of the base, indicating ~16 carbons. The exact mass matches the monoisotopic mass of C₁₆H₁₆O (16 C = 192.0000, 16 H = 16.1252, O = 15.9949; total = 224.1201). This formula also gives the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17.5 %, M+2 ≈ 1.6 %). Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₆O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H16O</final_answer>
